target.title: fix(audit): preserve emoji in npm registry errors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where dependency-audit failures could print malformed npm registry error text when a response placed an emoji across the 4096 UTF-16-unit diagnostic limit.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bulk-advisory error reader now reuses the repository's canonical surrogate-safe truncation helper while preserving its existing cap, timeout behavior, stream cleanup, and `[truncated]` marker. The repository's Node floor is above v22.18, where erasable TypeScript imports are enabled by default, so the directly executed MJS path can reuse the dependency-free source helper without duplicating it.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the npm response/error path, direct Node import contract, and shared helper implementation.

## User Impact

Dependency-audit errors remain valid Unicode when registry or proxy responses contain emoji. Successful audit JSON, ASCII output, timeout handling, byte limits, findings, and exit codes are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: `"abc\u{1f600}tail".slice(0, 4)` ends in lone UTF-16 code unit `0xd83d`.
- A live read-only POST to npm's documented Bulk Advisory endpoint returned `{}` for a valid package/version payload. See https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-audit/#bulk-advisory-endpoint.
- Node's direct TypeScript type-stripping contract: https://nodejs.org/download/release/v22.18.0/docs/api/typescript.html.
- Added focused coverage in `test/scripts/pnpm-audit-prod.test.ts` for split and complete surrogate-pair boundaries.
- `node --check scripts/pre-commit/pnpm-audit-prod.mjs`
- `git diff --check`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check scripts/pre-commit/pnpm-audit-prod.mjs test/scripts/pnpm-audit-prod.test.ts`
- Exact-head CI run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29404601065: `check-lint` passed and `test/scripts/pnpm-audit-prod.test.ts` passed 22 tests in `checks-node-compact-small-6`.
- The run's remaining failures are in untouched current-main surfaces: agent delegate test types, gateway method registration, state DB transaction isolation, and agent harness selection.
